LESSON: OUR MARKET

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social Environment
Topic 1.6: Our Market
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Our Market, part of Social Environment in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do you locate your local market? 2. Why do we go to the market?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Our Market together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: Teamwork as learners make a shop corner using locally available materials in groups.

Values:
 Respect: Open mindedness is enhanced as learners visit and interact with people in the nearest market

 Integrity: Honest and fair negotiations as learners role playing on buying and selling

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
 Citizenship: Acknowledgement for self and others as learners interact with people found in the market.

 Financial literacy: Spending skills as learners visit the nearest market to observe different activities that take place there.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Mathematics Activities: Concept of Money as learners role play buying and selling in the market.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Approved learning support materials, shop corner, Local environment with suitable environmental adaptations), theme based

Pictures/ Photographs/ Newspaper cuttings/ Flash cards/ charts with legible print and appropriate colour contrast on the market,
